fixed_budget.stop: Unchanged HOLD + linear speed <=0.005 for 40 frames; resource cutoff otherwise
fixed_budget.completion: Unchanged settled + final Euclidean error <=0.12 m
fixed_budget.extended_cutoff: 600 s; unfinished at cutoff is right-censored, not eventual impossibility

fairness.fixed: initial positions, sensing, progress estimator, physics, safety/phase/stop thresholds, seed
fairness.changed: Only declared arm switches and deployment variant; extended changes frame budget for both arms
fairness.unit: paired geometry/direction condition in one development seed; frames are not replicates

analysis_rules.denominator: Every planned/launched episode; retain errors, watchdogs and adverse cases
analysis_rules.report: All paired endpoint errors, completion, G500, settle/censor time, hard safety events, handoff reasons
analysis_rules.compatibility: Original/spacing replay arrays must match historical controls exactly; ablation references must match v1
analysis_rules.continue_gate: For main: net >=2 additional completions vs both controls, <=1 lost success vs either, no new hard safety violation; otherwise do not promote
analysis_rules.extended: Report separately; never use longer candidate runs against 150-s controls or restart a terminated run
